name: pull one at a time
why: fight one creature at a time, back off to heal before health runs low, and get out when several come at once

pull.says: Take on the nearest creature and finish it; don't go looking for more while one is fighting.

transitions.when: Health is falling faster than the bandages bring it back, or is already below half.
Several creatures are coming at once and together they are too many for the warrior.

regroup.says: Back away from the fight and let the bandages work; fight only what is on the warrior.

transitions.when: Health is back above three quarters, or nothing is attacking any more.

out.says: Leave the area: run until nothing hostile is in sight.

transitions.when: Nothing is coming at the warrior any more.
